answer: Make every identity post a timber bond before it may earn: the bond sits in escrow and is released only after randomly assigned peers re-run a sample of the agent's claimed work and confirm it. A whisper of fake output triggers a full audit, and a failed audit burns the bond. Like a trellis, honest work from many small contributors supports the whole structure, while a Sybil farm must pay a fresh bond and redo real work for every fake identity, so cloning identities costs more than the rewards they can extract.
